description: This file defines API routes for managing 'Brand' entities in an e-commerce backend, including CRUD operations, listing, and activation/deactivation, with role-based access control.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Adds a new brand after validating input and user role.

methods.name: GET /list
methods.description: Fetches list of active brands with merchant names.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Fetches list of brands, filtered by user merchant if applicable.

methods.name: GET /:id
methods.description: Fetches a specific brand by ID.

methods.name: GET /list/select
methods.description: Fetches list of brands with only name, filtered by user merchant if applicable.

methods.name: PUT /:id
methods.description: Updates brand details, including slug uniqueness check.

methods.name: PUT /:id/active
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a brand, disables products if deactivating.

methods.name: DELETE /delete/:id
methods.description: Deletes a brand and deactivates associated merchant.
